title: AI-Powered Payroll Solution (AI Payroll Guard)
summary: The UAE Ministry of Finance reports that AI Payroll Guard, which combines Llama 3.1 (8B) with robotic process automation, cut payroll processing time by up to 95 percent.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: On 16 October 2024 the UAE Ministry of Finance presented AI Payroll Guard at GITEX. The ministry states that the system uses Llama 3.1 (8B) with UiPath robotic process automation. In a project account current as of June 2025, the ministry reports that its live federal payroll system reduced processing time by up to 95 percent. The reported gain covers the wider automation of payroll. The share of the gain that is due to AI is unknown.
purpose: Automate payroll processing, validation, and exception handling.
model_version: Llama 3.1 (8B) with UiPath robotic process automation, Oracle payroll and an Impala data lake
deployer: UAE Ministry of Finance and federal entities

ratings.reason: The ministry reports that payroll processing takes up to 95 percent less time. The share of this gain that is due to AI is unknown.
The ministry intends that employees receive timely and accurate salaries. No source measures a change in missed or wrong payments.

ai_role.statement: AI is described as validating payroll data, detecting exceptions, and supporting the interface. Other automation also executes processing and payments, so AI's separate contribution is unknown.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
